=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitc writes the single byte c
fn emitc c uchar to void
b = new uchar 1 c
emit b
end
note each term reads the previous one as runs of equal digits, writing run length then digit
note bound: the 15th term has 102 digits; 256-byte buffers hold every term here, and no run is longer than 3
fn main to int
a = new uchar 256 0
b = new uchar 256 0
put a 0 1
n = ulong 1
for t ulong 15
for i ulong n
emitc add get a i uchar 48
end
emit nl
m = ulong 0
i = ulong 0
while lt i n bound 256
d = get a i
j = i
while lt j n bound 256
if ne get a j d
break
end
j = add j 1
end
put b m uchar sub j i
put b add m 1 d
m = add m 2
i = j
end
for k ulong m
put a k get b k
end
n = m
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
